Metadata.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
Metadata.summary: John McClane travels to Russia to help out his seemingly wayward son, Jack, only to discover that Jack is a CIA operative working undercover, causing the father and son to team up against underworld forces.

Image.alt: A Good Day to Die Hard
A Good Day to Die Hard

Metadata.title: A Silent Voice: The Movie
Metadata.summary: A deaf girl, Shoko, is bullied by the popular Shoya. As Shoya continues to bully Shoko, the class turns its back on him. Shoko transfers and Shoya grows up as an outcast. Alone and depressed, the regretful Shoya finds Shoko to make amends.
Metadata.tagline: Sometimes the answer is as simple as learning to listen.

Metadata.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
Metadata.summary: A faulty computer causes a passenger space shuttle to head straight for the sun, and man-with-a-past Ted Striker must save the day and get the shuttle back on track – again – all the while trying to patch up his relationship with Elaine.
Metadata.tagline: For the ride of your life... All you need for Christmas are your two front seats!

Metadata.title: Airplane!
Metadata.summary: After the crew becomes sick with food poisoning, a neurotic ex-fighter pilot must safely land a commercial airplane full of passengers.
Metadata.tagline: What's slower than a speeding bullet, and able to hit tall buildings at a single bound?

Metadata.title: Akira
Metadata.summary: A secret military project endangers Neo-Tokyo when it turns a teenage biker gang member into a rampaging psychic psychopath who can only be stopped by his best friend.

Metadata.title: Alien
Metadata.summary: During its return to the earth, commercial spaceship Nostromo intercepts a distress signal from a distant planet. When a three-member team of the crew discovers a chamber containing thousands of eggs on the planet, a creature inside one of the eggs attacks an explorer. The entire crew is unaware of the impending nightmare set to descend upon them when the alien parasite planted inside its unfortunate host is birthed.
Metadata.tagline: In space no one can hear you scream.

Metadata.title: Alien: Resurrection
Metadata.summary: The saga continues 200 years after Ripley sacrificed herself for the sake of humanity. Her erstwhile employers long gone, this time it is the military that resurrects the one-woman killing machine through genetic cloning to extract the alien from within her, but during the process her DNA is fused with the queen and then the aliens escape. Now Ripley must decide where her allegiance lies.

Metadata.title: Aliens
Metadata.summary: Ripley, the sole survivor of the Nostromo's deadly encounter with the monstrous Alien, returns to Earth after drifting through space in hypersleep for 57 years. Although her story is initially met with skepticism, she agrees to accompany a team of Colonial Marines back to LV-426.

Metadata.title: Alien³
Metadata.summary: Ellen Ripley is the only survivor when she crash lands on Fiorina 161, a bleak wasteland inhabited by former inmates of the planet's maximum security prison. Once again, Ripley must face skepticism and the alien as it hunts down the prisoners and guards. Without weapons or modern technology of any kind, Ripley leads the men into battle against the terrifying creature.
Metadata.tagline: 3 times the suspense. 3 times the danger. 3 times the terror

Metadata.title: An American Tail
Metadata.summary: Fievel is a young Russian mouse separated from his parents on the way to America, a land they think is without cats. When he arrives alone in the New World, he keeps up hope, searching for his family, making new friends, and running and dodging the cats he thought he'd be rid off.
Metadata.tagline: Meet Fievel. In his search to find his family, he discovered America.

Metadata.title: A Series of Unfortunate Events
Metadata.summary: After the Baudelaire parents die in a terrible fire, the Baudelaire orphans search for their families secrets and get them and their fortune away from the terrible grasp of the sinister Count Olaf as he moves with them between different guardians in disguise.
Metadata.tagline: Secrets will be revealed, one unfortunate event at a time.

Metadata.title: AHO-GIRL
Metadata.summary: Yoshiko Hanabatake is an idiot. She is so ditzy she gets zero on all her tests, she just wants to play and run around all day and not ponder her future, and she loves bananas. Her closest friends are Akuru Akutsu, a smart and serious student, and Sayaka Sumino, a kind and level-headed schoolgirl; both of whom must put up with Yoshiko's escapades.

Metadata.title: Abbott Elementary
Metadata.summary: A workplace comedy centered on a group of dedicated teachers - and an oblivious principal - in a Philadelphia public school where, despite the odds stacked against them, they are determined to help their students succeed in life.

Metadata.title: Adventure Time
Metadata.summary: A 12-year-old boy and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old dog with magical powers, go on a series of surreal adventures in a remote future.

Metadata.title: Adventure Time: Distant Lands
Metadata.summary: Four hour-long specials that explore the unseen corners of the world of Adventure Time with both familiar and exciting brand-new characters.

Metadata.title: Adventure Time: Fionna and Cake
Metadata.summary: Fionna and Cake--with help from the former Ice King, Simon Petrikov--embark on a multiverse-hopping adventure and journey of self-discovery. All the while, lurking in the shadows is a powerful new antagonist determined to track them down and erase them from existence.

Metadata.title: Adventure Time: Side Quests
Metadata.summary: The early days of Finn the Human and Jake the Dog's brotherly bond, embarking on epic quests together and hanging out with familiar faces along the way.

Metadata.title: Afro Samurai
Metadata.summary: A Black samurai goes on a mission to avenge the wrongful death of his father in a futuristic feudal Japan.

Metadata.title: Akudama Drive
Metadata.summary: Long ago, a war broke out in Japan that pitted Kantou against Kansai and divided the country. Kansai became dependent on Kantou, but slowly the police and government began losing control of Kansai to criminals known as Akudama.

Metadata.title: Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian
Metadata.originalTitle: 時々ボソッとロシア語でデレる隣のアーリャさん
Metadata.summary: Alisa Mikhailovna Kujou is considered the idol of her institute. She has conquered the hearts of countless male students, but she has her eyes on one Japanese boy who she flirts with in Russian, who also happens to understand Russian.

Metadata.title: American Dad!
Metadata.summary: The escapades of Stan Smith, a conservative C.I.A. Agent dealing with family life, while keeping America safe.
Metadata.tagline: From the creator of "Family Guy" comes a man who will stop at nothing to protect his country.

Metadata.title: Andor
Metadata.summary: In an era filled with danger, deception and intrigue, Cassian Andor will discover the difference he can make in the struggle against the tyrannical Galactic Empire. He embarks on a path that is destined to turn him into a rebel hero.

Metadata.title: Angel Beats!
Metadata.summary: For most, life ends after death, but not for this group of teenagers, trapped in a high school teetering between the lines of life and death. Frustrated at their premature and unfair deaths, the teens stage a rebellion against God, desperate for their lives to have amounted to something. But as time passes, it becomes clear that their purgatory is not what it seems, nor is the quiet angel they fight against.
Metadata.tagline: 1-2-3-4-5-6-7 All Good Children Go To Heaven (They Wish)

Metadata.title: Angels of Death
Metadata.summary: Most girls waking up without any memory and meeting a serial killer would panic, but not Rachel. In fact, far from being her biggest problem, killer Zack might just prove a convenient resource when it comes to finding a way out of the building in which they're both trapped!

Metadata.title: Animaniacs
Metadata.summary: The two Warner Brothers Yakko and Wakko and their Warner sister Dot had been (supposedly) created in the 1930's, but their cartoons were too screwy for the general public to handle. The three Warners were locked up in the studio water tower until they escaped in the 90's. There, they run wild, causing chaos everywhere!

Metadata.title: "I Love You" and Auto Memoir Dolls
Metadata.titleSort: I Love You" and Auto Memoir Dolls
Metadata.summary: Hodgins retrieves Violet from the hospital, as Major Gilbert asked him to look out for her. After they meet Gilbert's relatives, he offers her a job.

Metadata.title: 'Til Death Do Us Art
Metadata.summary: Linda becomes concerned when Gayle turns her love life into a performance art piece.

Metadata.title: 'Tis An Honor!
Metadata.summary: Jirocho and Gin battle Kada's elite Harusame forces while the rest of the denizens of Kabuki-cho take on her main forces in the streets. Kada is utterly stunned when her elite forces are beat by just these two humans, and flees the scene. Gin then helps Jirocho resolve his issues regarding Tatsugoro; Otose and Jirocho reconcile at the hospital. Outside the hospital, Kada desperately launches one last feeble attempt at conquering Kabuki-cho, but is stopped in her tracks by Pirako and the Yorozuya - Kada settles for swearing that the Harusame will be back, and flees yet again. At the very end, Jirocho denounces all other names he has ever been called except for Father of Pirako, and goes with his daughter back to the country.

Metadata.title: 'cause you are my God, Zack.
Metadata.titleSort: cause you are my God, Zack.
Metadata.summary: Gray proclaims himself closer to being a God than anyone else and sentences Rachel to burn alive for the things she did to the other floor masters. Hanging on her cross, Rachel insists that she's not a witch and that she only wants Zack to kill her.

Metadata.title: ...And Then There Were Four
Metadata.summary: The final four contestants reach the end of the competition as one final survivor is finally crowned winner.

Metadata.title: ...And Then There Were None
Metadata.summary: Eve, the Mother of All, unleashes a new monster upon the world: a black worm-slug that can enter the brain and force people to kill. Sam and Dean join forces with Bobby and Rufus and track it to a cannery, only to discover that Gwen and Samuel are also there looking for the monster... and none of them know who the monster is inside.

Metadata.title: ...And the Bag's in the River
Metadata.titleSort: And the Bag's in the River
Metadata.summary: Walter fights with Jesse over his drug use, causing him to leave Walter alone with their captive, Krazy-8. Meanwhile, Hank has a scared straight moment with Walter Jr. after his aunt discovers he has been smoking pot. Also, Skylar is upset when Walter stays away from home.

Metadata.title: ...Who Are You?!
Metadata.summary: With her bath made a mess by Momiji, Ichiko goes with Ranmaru to the public baths, where they are joined by Seiji and his family. The trip proves to be less than peaceful with Bobby and Momou trying to take a peek and Momiji up to her usual tricks. Realising Momiji hasn't had a bath in ages, Ichiko gives her and her familiar, Kumagai, a thorough cleaning. After Bobby makes light of Ranmaru's looks, she ends up busting down the wall between the men's and women's baths, leading to some embarrassing reveals. The next day, Ichiko is surprised to find Momiji with such a radiant personality.

Metadata.title: 10 Years of Glory, and It Continues
Metadata.originalTitle: 十年榮耀 一如既往
Metadata.summary: A longtime rival challenges Ye Xiu to a duel.

Metadata.title: 100 A.D. (1)
Metadata.summary: Hayley sends the family into chaos after she and her old boyfriend run off and elope. Stan offers a reward to whomever stops the couple, sparking a cannonball run through town in order to stop them.

Metadata.title: 100 Years a Solid Fool
Metadata.summary: While running an errand in Little Columbia, Stan is confronted by his hidden past.

Metadata.title: 10:00 A.M.
Metadata.summary: Bets are taken on the whereabouts of a stolen ambulance, while Santos learns a hard lesson, and Whitaker helps to tame “The Kraken.”

Metadata.title: 10:00 A.M.
Metadata.summary: With a nearby hospital shuttered on the busiest day of the year, Robby and team must field extra patients, including the victim of a parkour mishap.

Metadata.title: 11:00 A.M.
Metadata.summary: Santos and Collins each deal with moral quandaries. Samira’s careful approach earns praise from patients – and reproach from Robby.
